title: Size should be configurable when in a panel
line: System Monitor widgets in a panel get a "Width in panel" (or "Height in panel") setting, so a chart can be made wider or taller than its automatic size.
explanation: In a panel the widget's length comes only from the display style's compact representation (CompactSensorFace: golden ratio of the panel thickness for horizontal panels, square for vertical ones, capped at the enormous icon size), and nothing let the user change it. The applet now has a panelLength setting (0 = Automatic, the old behaviour). When it is set, the applet's compact representation uses it as preferred and maximum width in horizontal panels, or height in vertical ones, never below the style's minimum. The Appearance page shows it as a spin box row at the end of the existing form, only when the widget is in a panel.

commits.message:
applets/systemmonitor: allow setting the size in a panel

System Monitor widgets in a panel always took the size their display
style picked, so a line chart couldn't be made wider or a widget in a
vertical panel taller. Add a "Width/Height in panel" setting for this.

BUG: 415981

patches.diff:
From fed740fcbf7b4dbed5795ad8d7e82822f560f450 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 19:35:56 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/systemmonitor: allow setting the size in a panel

System Monitor widgets in a panel always took the size their display
style picked, so a line chart couldn't be made wider or a widget in a
vertical panel taller. Add a "Width/Height in panel" setting for this.

BUG: 415981
---
 .../package/contents/config/main.xml          |  3 ++
 .../contents/ui/CompactRepresentation.qml     | 12 ++++---
 .../contents/ui/config/ConfigAppearance.qml   | 32 +++++++++++++++++++
 3 files changed, 43 insertions(+), 4 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/systemmonitor/systemmonitor/package/contents/config/main.xml b/applets/systemmonitor/systemmonitor/package/contents/config/main.xml
index a7d3191ceb..bd7436d3ef 100644
--- a/applets/systemmonitor/systemmonitor/package/contents/config/main.xml
+++ b/applets/systemmonitor/systemmonitor/package/contents/config/main.xml
@@ -10,6 +10,9 @@
     <entry name="chartFace" type="String">
       <default>org.kde.ksysguard.piechart</default>
     </entry>
+    <entry name="panelLength" type="Int">
+      <default>0</default>
+    </entry>
   </group>
 
   <group name="Sensors">
diff --git a/applets/systemmonitor/systemmonitor/package/contents/ui/CompactRepresentation.qml b/applets/systemmonitor/systemmonitor/package/contents/ui/CompactRepresentation.qml
index 6e9ef5b4da..7ec04f8da9 100644
--- a/applets/systemmonitor/systemmonitor/package/contents/ui/CompactRepresentation.qml
+++ b/applets/systemmonitor/systemmonitor/package/contents/ui/CompactRepresentation.qml
@@ -24,11 +24,15 @@ Control {
     Layout.minimumWidth: (contentItem ? contentItem.Layout.minimumWidth : 0) + leftPadding + rightPadding
     Layout.minimumHeight: (contentItem ? contentItem.Layout.minimumHeight : 0) + leftPadding + rightPadding
 
-    Layout.preferredWidth: (contentItem ? contentItem.Layout.preferredWidth : 0) + leftPadding + rightPadding
-    Layout.preferredHeight: (contentItem ? contentItem.Layout.preferredHeight : 0) + leftPadding + rightPadding
+    readonly property int panelLength: Plasmoid.configuration.panelLength
+    readonly property bool fixedWidth: panelLength > 0 && Plasmoid.formFactor === PlasmaCore.Types.Horizontal
+    readonly property bool fixedHeight: panelLength > 0 && Plasmoid.formFactor === PlasmaCore.Types.Vertical
 
-    Layout.maximumWidth: (contentItem ? contentItem.Layout.maximumWidth : 0) + leftPadding + rightPadding
-    Layout.maximumHeight: (contentItem ? contentItem.Layout.maximumHeight : 0) + leftPadding + rightPadding
+    Layout.preferredWidth: fixedWidth ? Math.max(panelLength, Layout.minimumWidth) : (contentItem ? contentItem.Layout.preferredWidth : 0) + leftPadding + rightPadding
+    Layout.preferredHeight: fixedHeight ? Math.max(panelLength, Layout.minimumHeight) : (contentItem ? contentItem.Layout.preferredHeight : 0) + leftPadding + rightPadding
+
+    Layout.maximumWidth: fixedWidth ? Layout.preferredWidth : (contentItem ? contentItem.Layout.maximumWidth : 0) + leftPadding + rightPadding
+    Layout.maximumHeight: fixedHeight ? Layout.preferredHeight : (contentItem ? contentItem.Layout.maximumHeight : 0) + leftPadding + rightPadding
 
     leftPadding: 0
     topPadding: 0
diff --git a/applets/systemmonitor/systemmonitor/package/contents/ui/config/ConfigAppearance.qml b/applets/systemmonitor/systemmonitor/package/contents/ui/config/ConfigAppearance.qml
index 8b5c15e4c2..6e9ea8b65f 100644
--- a/applets/systemmonitor/systemmonitor/package/contents/ui/config/ConfigAppearance.qml
+++ b/applets/systemmonitor/systemmonitor/package/contents/ui/config/ConfigAppearance.qml
@@ -7,7 +7,10 @@
 */
 
 import QtQuick
+import QtQuick.Controls as QQC2
 
+import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
+import org.kde.plasma.core as PlasmaCore
 import org.kde.plasma.plasmoid
 import org.kde.kcmutils as KCM
 
@@ -16,6 +19,8 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
 
     signal configurationChanged
 
+    property alias cfg_panelLength: panelLengthSpinBox.value
+
     function saveConfig() {
         configUi.saveConfig()
         Plasmoid.faceController.reloadConfig()
@@ -41,6 +46,33 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
             property: "width"
             value: contents.width
         }
+
+        QQC2.SpinBox {
+            id: panelLengthSpinBox
+
+            // Added as the last row of the face's appearance form, and taken
+            // out of it again before that form and its engine are destroyed
+            parent: root.configUi
+            Component.onDestruction: parent = null
+            visible: Plasmoid.formFactor === PlasmaCore.Types.Horizontal || Plasmoid.formFactor === PlasmaCore.Types.Vertical
+
+            Kirigami.FormData.label: Plasmoid.formFactor === PlasmaCore.Types.Vertical ? i18nc("@label:spinbox", "Height in panel:") : i18nc("@label:spinbox", "Width in panel:")
+
+            from: 0
+            to: 1000
+            editable: true
+
+            textFromValue: function(value, locale) {
+                if (value <= 0) {
+                    return i18nc("@item:inrange size of the widget in the panel", "Automatic");
+                }
+                return value.toString();
+            }
+            valueFromText: function(text, locale) {
+                const value = parseInt(text);
+                return isNaN(value) ? 0 : value;
+            }
+        }
     }
 
     Connections {
--
